intent: Revise the selected Profile prototype: remove the page-level 我的 heading and compact the identity row. No application code changes.
data_notice: All names and health values are illustrative prototype data.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the user's selected 称小二 personal-profile screen. Edit this exact screen, do not invent a new design.
Primary request: remove the redundant large page title "我的" below the brand header and make the identity section significantly smaller. Preserve the rest of the chosen design.

Only requested layout changes:
1. Completely remove the large navy page heading "我的" between the brand header and the profile identity card, AND remove the vertical space reserved for it. DO NOT remove "我的" from the bottom navigation; that active tab label stays.
2. Replace the oversized white avatar/name card with a compact horizontal identity strip, about 55–60% of its former HEIGHT. Keep the same full-width alignment and white rounded surface, but reduce vertical padding strongly. Avatar should be a small peach rounded square, roughly HALF its current width/height (around 60–64 pixels if the whole screen is 851 pixels wide). Retain the letter "林". Nickname "小林" should be smaller and proportionate, roughly 28–30 pixels at that screen width rather than a large heading. Keep "手机号已验证" as a quiet secondary caption; a compact two-line name/caption beside the small avatar is appropriate. Keep a smaller lavender pencil icon button at the far right, comfortably aligned. No big portrait or decorative banner.
3. Flow the health-profile card and all subsequent content UPWARD into the recovered space. Preserve a modest natural gap between the brand header, compact identity row and health card. Do NOT leave a blank hole where the title used to be. Do NOT compensate by enlarging other cards, adding text or stretching row heights. It is okay to have comfortable empty canvas near the bottom after the content ends.

Strict invariants:
Keep the same full portrait screen, original aspect ratio, iOS status bar, upper brand scale icon and exact app name "称小二", the "已同步" pill, warm-white canvas, apricot/indigo/pastel palette, white rounded cards, shadow style, icon language, crisp simplified-Chinese typography, and bottom tab bar anchored to the screen bottom.
The indigo "健康档案" card keeps its original width, approximate height, decorative arcs, edit pencil, "当前体重 79.0 kg", "目标体重 73 kg", "170 cm · 30–39 岁", "目标日期 12月28日". Do not change any numeric values.
Keep the "为你定制" group and its two rows "教练记住的你" with "目标、习惯与限制", and "日常提醒" with "称重、饮食与晚间复盘", "2 项开启".
Keep the "连接与账号" group and its rows "连接微信" with "未连接", and "账号与说明" with "资料安全、健康边界与账号管理". Keep the quiet footer "按自己的节奏，慢慢来。".
Bottom tabs stay exactly "今天", "教练", "趋势", "我的", ONLY 我的 active with apricot person-outline on indigo backplate.
No new features, no extra cards, no new title replacing 我的, no external labels, no watermark, no device frame, no debug gear. Clean native UI mockup, not a poster.
